name: WP Critique
description: French WordPress help: assistance, migration, speed, malware removal, and hosting (company-stated). On-demand support from €39 (company-stated). Founded Aug 2019, France. Listed for sale at $60,000, about 1.8× (TrustMRR). L30 profit margin 90% (TrustMRR snapshot).

mentions.evidence: ~$240 MRR, 6 active subscriptions, ~$2,712 L30 (+946.7%), ~$4,415 last 3 months, ~$7,630 last 6 months, ~$13,909 last 12 months, ~$119,067 all-time. L30 profit margin 90% (TrustMRR snapshot). Asking price $60,000. Revenue synced Oct 16, 2026 ~04:39 Warsaw.

whyItPrints: Site owners panic-pay when WordPress breaks or gets infected. French-language support is the moat. The margin on the snapshot is very high.
whyThisMatters:
Your WordPress site is down, or it got weird, or you need it moved to a new host. WP Critique is the French shop you call. Help, repairs, and moves start at a small fixed price. Making the site faster costs more. Cleaning malware costs more than that. They also sell hosting and a maintenance plan so the next update is not a Friday surprise. The address on the site is in La Wantzenau. The page shows a top rating from about seventy reviews.

The company dates to 2019. Six subscriptions is a small seat count next to a busy last 30 days, which fits panic jobs billed once, not a monthly login. The listing is for sale at a price that is not wild next to a year of cash, and the all-time total is much older than that year. The margin on the snapshot is very high. That fits a person fixing a site, not a product with servers to feed.

You pay so the site is back before the weekend.
